items.title: The cotangent complex of an algebraic space over a ring is the cotangent complex of sheaves of rings

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a ring Lambda and an algebraic space X over Lambda one has L_{X/Spec(Lambda)} = L_{O_X/Lambda}, the constant sheaf with value Lambda on X_etale (source lines 4517-4526). The proof considers the structure morphism p : X -> Spec(Lambda) and the obvious morphism q : Spec(Lambda)_etale -> (*, Lambda), and uses the distinguished triangle for ringed topoi to reduce to showing L_q = 0. That vanishing is checked on stalks at a geometric point: the stalk of L_q is identified with the cotangent complex of the etale local ring of Spec(Lambda) at that point over Lambda, which is zero because that ring is a strict henselization of a local ring of Lambda.
